title: Deterministic failures in Replay Vision activities must raise non-retryable ApplicationError
answers: Missing ExportedAsset in prepare_observation_thumbnail_activity keeps retrying
How to fail a Replay Vision activity without Temporal retries
body:
In products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/activities/observation_media.py:prepare_observation_thumbnail_activity, deterministic failures (analysis asset row missing via ExportedAsset.DoesNotExist, or empty content_location) must raise `ApplicationError(..., non_retryable=True)`. Otherwise Temporal burns all retry attempts on something that cannot recover.
When adding lookups to these activities, catch DoesNotExist and convert it. Test pattern is in products/replay_vision/backend/tests/test_observation_media.py (asserts caught.value.non_retryable is True).
